title: Frontend: Create project modal/wizard — name, type, vision, optional milestone templates
description: Multi-step dialog for creating a new project: Step 1 (name + type), Step 2 (vision/description), Step 3 (optional milestone templates for software or AI suggestions for others).
acceptanceCriteria: Step 1: project name input + type selector (6 types as radio/card options)
Step 3: for software type — predefined milestone templates (checkboxes); for others — skip or show AI suggestions
Create button on final step submits to API
On success: invalidate projects query, close modal, navigate to new project

steps.details: Create src/components/projects/CreateProjectModal.tsx. Use shadcn/ui Dialog. Manage step state (1, 2, 3). Step 1: controlled Input for name + type cards (6 options, each as a clickable Card with icon and label). Step 2: Textarea for description. Step 3: depends on type.

PREDEFINED_SOFTWARE_MILESTONES = ['Set up repository and CI/CD', 'Configure authentication', 'Set up database and ORM', 'Build core features', 'Write tests', 'Set up production deployment', 'Launch v1.0']. Render as Checkbox list. User can select which to include.

On Create: POST /api/projects with { name, description, type, milestoneTemplates: selectedTemplates }. On success: queryClient.invalidateQueries(['projects']), close dialog, navigate('/projects/' + newProject.id).
Open modal, fill name, select 'software' type, add vision, select 3 milestone templates. Create — verify navigates to new project. Verify milestones are pre-created.
